title: Two US States Went To War Over One Strip Of Land 🗺️
caption:
Two US states went to war over one strip of land 🗺️
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1835 Ohio and the Michigan Territory both claimed the Toledo Strip and sent militias to the border. The conflict was almost bloodless. Congress settled it: Ohio kept Toledo and Michigan got most of the Upper Peninsula, which turned out to hold huge amounts of copper, iron and timber.
Who won, Ohio or Michigan? 👇
first_comment: Ohio got a city. Michigan got copper, iron and timber. Who won? 🗺️👇
